transcription_check.scope: Faithful transcription of digital PDF, including visible defects; not archival verification.

notes.manas-2010:p0744:b001:l001: Бел support/ridge metaphor, defensive pillar reading.
notes.manas-2010:p0744:b001:l008: Ruler not God but divine-like deeds is speaker boast, not narrator theological claim.
notes.manas-2010:p0744:b001:l012: Six horses and palm-sized letter explicit, no invented six messengers.
notes.manas-2010:p0744:b001:l016: Imperative going to explain retained; whether addressed Manas personally or delegated envoy not specified.
notes.manas-2010:p0744:b001:l019: Чынар plane-tree, garden and throne symbols of rule; not silently converted to palace.
notes.manas-2010:p0744:b001:l022: Чет-Бээжин Outer Beijing, epic region not modern municipal boundary.
notes.manas-2010:p0744:b001:l027: Repeated fly-sized life and benefit comparisons retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0744:b001:l038: Ак үйлүү literal white dwelling; frontier rulership setting. Institution unresolved between hostage and power/wealth senses; see743:l026 notes.
notes.manas-2010:p0745:b001:l003: Сынчы discernment experts assessing character/potential, not necessarily literary critics or judicial officers.
notes.manas-2010:p0745:b001:l009: Кызыр divine helper Khizir, благословение rendering, no actual appearance added.
notes.manas-2010:p0745:b001:l011: Institutional white dwelling literal as earlier; no hostage assertion.
notes.manas-2010:p0745:b001:l017: Kara-Kyr tea source retained without botanical or modern geographic identification.
notes.manas-2010:p0745:b001:l021: Түмөндөгөн tens of thousands, hyperbolic many ten-thousands preserved; no exact count invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0745:b001:l024: Агала чап printed mixed capitalization, treated place with Kyzyl-Kum; precise proper-name boundary uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0745:b001:l026: Double negative of play/enjoyment and staying with speaker retained; syntax provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0745:b001:l031: Теңизим my ocean vocative praise of Manas, not a new named Tengiz.
notes.manas-2010:p0745:b001:l032: Сөз words remaining after death, potential aftermath/reputation; no explicit claim immortality.
notes.manas-2010:p0745:b001:l033: Кун blood-price/compensation obligation, continuing threat of reprisal from sixty sons in next verses; no exact legal sum.
notes.manas-2010:p0745:b001:l035: Exactly sixty sons and sixty nobles in l038 retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0745:b001:l039: Alööke himself in bonds, not necessarily youngest son bound.
notes.manas-2010:p0745:b001:l040: Ажайып wondrous arts; no unsupported institution named Ajayyp.
notes.manas-2010:p0746:b001:l003: Sixty-headed dragon and six-year tutelage literal fantasy.
notes.manas-2010:p0746:b001:l007: Сан epic multitude/counting unit not given a fixed census; six multitudes retained distinctly from six individual survivors.
notes.manas-2010:p0746:b001:l008: All six multitudes slain followed by six returnees in next verse, numerical/generalization tension retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0746:b001:l014: Чубатууга filing/parading; object not explicit. Discerning assessors filing past boy is provisional; could refer to boys presented for assessment.
notes.manas-2010:p0746:b001:l017: Hearts bursting from fright is narrator hyperbole, repeated at l027.
notes.manas-2010:p0746:b001:l020: Hearth ember origin metaphor retained, not adding actual fire birth.
notes.manas-2010:p0746:b001:l021: Canonical Kongurbay name; identifies youngest son after long build-up.
notes.manas-2010:p0746:b001:l023: Калдай governor/rank rather than a new person Kalday.
notes.manas-2010:p0746:b001:l029: Керүүгө салган там defensive house upon grassy upland metaphor, not construction of a new residence; dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/керүү/ and earlier520:l039.
notes.manas-2010:p0746:b001:l032: Кечил epic Kalmyks sense, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/кечил/ gives exact Kongurbay khan formula; edition1839:l015–016 also distinguishes monks/Kalmyks.
notes.manas-2010:p0746:b001:l037: First person return to Alööke offer after son narrative, not Kongurbay speaking.
notes.manas-2010:p0746:b001:l040: Offer to make Kongurbay companion, not accepted friendship yet.
